subtitle: How well do you really know your people?
author: Dennis Nickens, AKA Spiritual Romeo

cards.text: When [Subject]'s friend is going through something hard, [Subject] usually:

options.text: Drops everything and shows up in person
Sends a thoughtful text and follows up later
Waits to be asked because they don't want to overstep
Means well but forgets to follow through

cards.playNotes: Other players each pick a letter. Reveal at the same time. Subject reveals which is true. Scoring: 2 points for the correct letter. Subject gets 1 point for every correct guess.

cards.text: If you texted [Subject] at 2 a.m. saying "are you up?" they would:

If Subject would call someone NOT at the table, no one scores on the point but Subject reveals who. Scoring: 2 points for correctly pointing. 3 points to Subject if a majority pointed correctly.
